name: Summer Camp at RTP Estuary Center
description_short: Weekly nature and science day camp at the Connecticut Audubon Society's Roger Tory Peterson Estuary Center in Old Lyme, with Ecology Camp for ages 5 to 10 and Junior Naturalists for ages 11 to 13. Each week has a theme such as estuary life, birds or art and science, with most of the day spent outdoors.

fees.name: Membership
fees.note: Connecticut Audubon Society, Chickadee family level or higher, current at registration and during camp

refund_policy_summary: Optional Registration Protection gives a full refund for listed reasons. Without it, changes need two weeks' notice by email; cancellations before June 1 are refunded less 20%, none after June 1. Membership fees are not refunded.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. RTP Estuary Center Summer Camps 2026: Ecology Camp (ages 5 to 10) and Junior Naturalists (ages 11 to 13), weekly sessions; 2026 season closed. Families must hold a Connecticut Audubon membership at Chickadee level ($58 family) or higher. This page gives the phone as 203-598-4218; the center contact block gives 860-598-4218.

Researched by Claude from this page. Nine one-week sessions June 22 to August 21, 9:00 to 4:00. $375 per week, $300 for the four day holiday week. After care 4 to 5pm, $20 per day. The four day week is printed as 'June 26 - July 2', which overlaps week 1, so it is left out of sessions; the year comes from the main summer camp page (2026).
Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 welcome letter: camp is at 100 Lyme Street; families pack lunch and two snacks.
